purpose: One fixed matched developmental joint-fit screen after synthetic qualification; no legacy full baseline reproduction.

data.selected_split: Existing R72 evaluation partition; no new cohort, sampling or official valid/test.

same_init: Original native state_dict and epoch orders shared; record exact identities; do not reuse old control metrics as newly matched execution.
primary: Positive39 Macro-F1 with all39 included; absent class F1=0, fixed cohort denominator.
discovery_gate: Centered_full Macro strictly above native/full/simplex/centered_native and CE no worse than native and centered_native; retain all signed deltas. Otherwise no automatic formal promotion; short normal null is inconclusive.
attribution: Centered_native/full difference tests update beyond decoder restriction; construction_only isolates readout centering; no quantum-necessity claim.
recovery: One attempt, no automatic replay or optional seed/epoch/eta/epsilon/centering-weight rescue. Restart from durable inputs only after a separately authorized new contract.
persistence: Future final models only if an active analysis/continuation consumer exists; no COS transfer in this design. Stopped screens Git code/compact reports by default.
